title: Hitbox for medic kit
script:
_G.Disabled = false  
_G.NearSize = 2  
_G.MiddleSize = 10  
_G.FarSize = 20  
_G.NearDistance = 20  
_G.FarDistance = 170  

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function updatePlayers()
    if _G.Disabled then return end  

    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end  

    for _, v in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character then
            local rootPart = v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if rootPart then
                local distance = (rootPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude

                pcall(function()
                    if distance <= _G.NearDistance then
                        rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(_G.NearSize, _G.NearSize, _G.NearSize)
                        rootPart.Transparency = 0.9  
                        rootPart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")  
                        rootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                    elseif distance >= _G.FarDistance then
                        rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(_G.FarSize, _G.FarSize, _G.FarSize)
                        rootPart.Transparency = 0.6  
                        rootPart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Lavender")  
                        rootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        rootPart.CanCollide = false
                    else
                        rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(_G.MiddleSize, _G.MiddleSize, _G.MiddleSize)
                        rootPart.Transparency = 0.7  
                        rootPart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Lavender")
                        rootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        rootPart.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        updatePlayers()
        task.wait(1)  
    end
end)

features:
✅ Dynamic Hitbox Scaling – The size of players' hitboxes changes based on distance:

Near (≤ 20 studs): Small (Size: 2, Almost invisible)

Middle (20 - 170 studs): Medium (Size: 10, Semi-transparent)

Far (≥ 170 studs): Large (Size: 20, Slightly transparent)


✅ Smooth Transition – The script automatically adjusts in real-time based on player distance.


The hitbox transparency & color are adjustable if you want to modify them.
